name: Southern Latex Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Southern Latex Ltd manufactures and sells rubberized coir products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
Company was incorporated to carry on the business of manufacturing, processing, selling of rubberized coir products and also trading of coir and its related products. However, with change in policy and demand of market, the business went down and the company was not able to grow. At present, management is exploring all options to bring new business to Company. It has identified new product lines and are in the process of being implemented. Also, company is planning to venture into new business opportunities and diversify its operations

cons: Stock is trading at 6.16 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 3.68% over last 3 years.
